deployments_detail.use: Indeed's Core AI team fine-tunes and deploys open-source LLMs on Amazon SageMaker to power HR-specific tasks: match explanations, job-description generation, resume/job skill extraction, match labeling, and career guides. Runs in production serving job matching at scale. [AWS (Amazon SageMaker, Hugging Face TGI, open-source LLMs)]
deployments_detail.value: Over 6.5M live production requests served; up to 3M requests/day; 67% cheaper than third-party vendor models; P99 latency under 7s; 75+ models fine-tuned; 4-5x improvement on HR-specific tasks

deployments_detail.use: Indeed Smart Sourcing: AI-powered candidate sourcing suite that uses Indeed's AI matching engine to recommend candidates from ~300M-worker talent pool, generates AI candidate summaries explaining fit, and drafts AI-powered outreach messages to accelerate hiring. [Indeed (in-house AI matching)]
deployments_detail.value: Matched candidates 17x more likely to apply when invited; 83% of employers call it their most effective communication method; 78% cite it as fastest way to make quality hires; one client saw 30% improvement in response rates

deployments_detail.use: Indeed Talent Scout: AI-powered conversational hiring agent for employers that sources, matches, and reaches out to candidates, provides real-time insights, and recommends job-post improvements; integrates with the employer's ATS. Launched at FutureWorks 2025. [Indeed (in-house AI agent)]
deployments_detail.value: Over 1,000 employers already using it; BrightSpring Health Services reported 45% increase in hard-to-fill hires within four weeks; users saved eight hours weekly

deployments_detail.use: Indeed Career Scout: AI career-coach agent for job seekers that learns skills, commute preferences, schedule and salary beyond a traditional resume to match people with roles, tailor resumes, and prep for interviews. Rolling out in the Indeed app. [Indeed (in-house AI agent)]
deployments_detail.value: 84% of job seekers find it valuable; 7x faster job discovery and application vs mobile app users; 38% increased likelihood of getting hired

deployments_detail.use: Indeed AI-driven job matching and recommendations engine: machine-learning algorithms match job seekers with employers, driving the majority of applications on the platform through recommendations and sourcing tools rather than keyword search. [Indeed (in-house ML)]
deployments_detail.value: ~70% of applications come from AI-driven recommendations/sourcing (vs ~30% keyword search); 31 hires per minute (one person hired every ~2 seconds); Premium Sponsored Jobs cut time-to-hire ~50%

deployments_detail.use: Indeed AI Mock Interview tool (part of Career Scout): generates a report and personalized feedback based on a job seeker's responses to behavioral interview questions to help candidates prepare. [Indeed (in-house AI)]
Indeed AI recruitment: interview automation, "Career Scout"/"Talent Scout" AI matching, AI job-data refinement
deployments_detail.value: ~1,300 Indeed/Glassdoor layoffs attributed to AI restructuring

deployments_detail.use: Salesforce AI agents deployed for go-to-market activities, plus internal agentic products, built primarily on AWS Bedrock-type platforms and in-house developer tools; company remains model-agnostic (currently using OpenAI-based models among others). [Salesforce (Agentforce), AWS Bedrock, OpenAI]
deployments_detail.value: 4 Salesforce agents deployed for go-to-market; 6 internal agentic products in production; 20+ additional agents in development

deployments_detail.use: Indeed intelligent risk management / trust and safety: AI-based system to manage fraud and risk across the platform, presented as an AWS re:Invent 2025 session on scaling responsible AI. [AWS]

AI scoring of sales conversations: Indeed uses AI to analyze recorded sales conversations, identify patterns from top performers, and coach underperforming sales teams (sales enablement). [Indeed (in-house AI)]
